name: statusline
description: Status rows above the prompt (context fill, 5h and 7d limits, model, session, branch, turns, transcript, graft, project colour) plus the session files other tools read. Replaces a statusLine command.

enabled.title: Show the status rows
enabled.description: Kill switch. Off draws nothing and writes nothing.

claudeDir.title: Claude config folder
claudeDir.description: Where the rate-limit cache, usage-limits cache, refresh script and project-colors.json live. ~ is your home.

snapshotDir.title: Snapshot folder
snapshotDir.description: Each session writes <session id>.json here (rendered rows + raw numbers) every 30 seconds and after each turn, for other tools to read. Empty turns it off.

legacyFiles.title: Write the files the old status line wrote
legacyFiles.description: <config>/cache/rate-limits/<session>.json (auto-resume supervisor), /tmp/claude-ctx-<session>.json (context monitor), and kick the usage-limits refresh script. Off if you do not run those tools.
